classification_notes: Manchester City discloses matchday, broadcasting, and commercial revenue directly in the annual accounts, with broadcasting split between UEFA and all-other lines that have been combined here. Player-trading profit is disclosed separately and excluded from football revenue.
women_team_treatment_notes: Women's team revenue is not separately disclosed in the report.
non_football_revenue_notes: Other commercial activities may include hospitality, sponsorship, concerts, conferences, and events within the club's commercial operations.
source_document: Full accounts made up to 30 June 2018
notes: Values in the annual report were disclosed in GBP thousands and have been converted here into full GBP amounts by multiplying by 1,000. The prior period covered 13 months, so the comparative season is not fully comparable. Net debt has been computed from borrowings in the finance lease note less cash at bank and in hand from the balance sheet.
